m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: More questions? Milkwebs? Too clingy! We don't touch! You ask Lieutenant Z'ur Grush!
Are you here to fight me? I will surely fight you! What's that, you do not need to fight? Alright, then.
You are entangled by Milkwebs? They are gummy and tenacious. I avoid them at all costs. Hard to scrape off all my feet.
Zexia SteelWeaver would know. She excels at crafting with them. Let me think now. My men told me something about her.
Ah, yes. She's in the Wampey Cave. Did I mention she was abducted by a Scarlet Woolly? Terrifying monster. Good luck.
Sniff. Sniff. What's that smell? A Spellbinder!? I thought they smelled bad on the inside!
Thank you Spellbinder! I was afraid I'd be braiding his hair forever! Quickly, let us be away from this place.
You are trying to weave with Milkwebs? That is very tricky, even for me. I imagine it sticks to your hair... and eyebrows... and eyelashes.
But if you sift a little dust on the Milkwebs first, they become much easier to handle. Like this, see? There, you've got it.
All we need to do is sprinkle some dust on it first? Excellent! Now, to get it all out of my fur...
I suppose the Digger Drones must know how one is to use these blasted, viscous Milkwebs.
I'll keep trying, but I need you to question some Digger Drones. Don't take "ugh" for an answer.
Make the Digger Drones tell you how one is to handle these... tacky Milkwebs.
